title: Fast-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Test-time Future Imagination?
authors: Tianyuan Yuan, Zibin Dong, Yicheng Liu, Hang Zhao

tldr.en: Retain video co-training but remove explicit future generation at inference, separating training representations from deployment cost.
tldr.zh: 保留视频联合训练，在推理时移除显式未来生成，区分训练表征收益与部署成本。

evaluation_scope.en: LIBERO, RoboTwin and real tasks; the paper reports 190 ms under its evaluation setup.
evaluation_scope.zh: LIBERO、RoboTwin 与真机；论文在其评测设置下报告 190 ms。
